_about: The story's opening, a beat at a time (scripts/story.gd runs it on a new game). Each beat: id, objective (the card's title), hint (how to do it), guide (true: the starter guide, its card over her head; the story's own, at the right under the map), parts (optional: [text, what does it], shown after the hint and lit up as she does each: walk, run, jump, strike, cast (a skill; cast:Spell for that one), eat, sleep, have:Thing:n, built:Prop, stored:Thing:n; {progress} in its text shows how far along, 3/10), start (what happens as it begins), done (what ends it), after (what happens as it ends). start/after actions: {do: spawn, what: slime|boar|mutatedVillager, count, near (units from Sera)}, {do: give, what, n}, {do: stock, what: {resource: n} (into the village's storage)}, {do: time, hour}, {do: clock, run: true|false}, {do: wake}, {do: messenger}, {do: mist_in}, {do: attack, count}, {do: ward}, {do: level, to}, {do: learn, talent (and the way to it; free)}, {do: wave, count (more of the horde, from every side)}, {do: to_bed (everyone in the village home to bed)}, {do: regroup (the village's people to the banner)}, {do: gather, who: [uniques] (up and out by the town banner, out of bed, held there)}, {do: release}, {do: mark, who (a unique: a ring and an arrow to them, for the beat)}, {do: record, event}, {do: say, text}, {do: cast, spell, after (seconds; Sera casts it herself)}, {do: sera_says, text, walk (said in her bubble once she's walked that far in the beat)}. done kinds: walked (units), killed (what, count: since the beat began), opened (character|talents), have (what: {resource: n} in her bag), built (what: [props], in_village), cooked (count of dishes cooked, since the beat began), slept (seconds: asleep that long, and she can't get up till the story wakes her), scene (id), reach_village, raid_over, stored (what: {resource: n} more in storage), houses (min condition), stored_dishes (count), morning, event (a chronicle event), item (what: a piece of gear she has, in her bag or storage). Parts also take item:Gear and event:name. build: [names] (all the build menu offers while it's on). pace: the clock's speed while the beat's on (1 as usual; kept to it, not while she sleeps). awake: true, the village stays up (nobody goes to bed) while it's on. give: {to: a unique, dishes: n, event} (talking to them with that many dishes hands them over, the event written). hidden: true, no card while it waits (the game runs as usual: {do: open} lets newcomers come and the clock run).

parts: W A S D to walk

beats.hint: Something's come out of the mist.
More slimes along the road. Try your skill from the bar below:
parts: 1 to aim Fireball, click where it lands

beats.hint: E by a tree to chop, by a rock to mine.
A boar in the trees, and slimes. Boar meat can be cooked.
At the lit bonfire, hold E with raw meat in your bag.

parts: Z by your bed to sleep

beats.hint: Up the road north, then east to the houses. Hurry.

start.text: Oh no! The mist is already here.

beats.hint: They're everywhere. Protect who you can.

after.text: Something answers her inside: she can call an Attack Shikigami now.

beats.hint: The elder is with them. E to talk.
They've had nothing since the attack. They bring out the meat they saved: cook it at a fire, then take the dishes to the elder.
There's a bed for you in the village tonight. Z to sleep.

after.text: Morning... The elder looks like he hasn't slept.

beats.hint: Slimes drop mist crystals; three and some wood make a Cleansing Crystal, which clears the mist round it. B to build:
Rods, buckets, wands and clothes are all made at a Tool Workbench. B to build:
E at the workbench, and make a Fishing Rod. The villagers have spared you some fiber for its line.
Fish feeds the village all year round, winter too. The river runs just west of the fence: build a Fishing Dock on its bank (B, under Farming), then E at it to cast.
